text:
Ana: quick sync — onboarding zeta-lite-1.0 weights. HF path is `hf://redwood/zeta-lite/1.0` but CI mirror failed with 403 when presigning. can someone confirm who owns the registry path and whether we should mirror or stream from HF? :thinking:
Matt: afaik ownership is infra-team-ml. @Devon do you still have the role that can presign?
Devon: i do. i checked; the HF model has two artifacts: `pytorch_model.bin` and `tokenizer.json`. HF origin is public but we require internal mirroring for Dedicated. presign failure was because the S3 bucket policy rejects PUTs unless we add a specific x-amz-meta tag.
Ana: ugh — tokenizers are throwing a weird decode on a small subset of tokens in our smoke tests (split on U+00A0). question: if we mirror, do we transform tokenizer.json or keep original?
Saria: prefer keeping original for provenance. we can add a post-mirror hook that runs a tokenizer-normalize step and store a normalized copy as `tokenizer.normalized.json` alongside weights. keeps audit trail. :white_check_mark:
Devon: checksum mismatch note — HF lists `sha256:abc123...` but our mirror job computed md5. we should standardize on sha256 in the registry metadata. CI lint should fail if checksum type differs.
Matt: +1 on sha256. also presign TTL — current default is 1h which is fine for a single machine pull but our mirror job runs across shards and can take 20-30m. suggest 2h. @InfraBot can we have a shorter TTL override on CI for ephemeral pulls?
InfraBot: infra note: presign TTL adjustable per job. set `PRESIGN_TTL=7200` in the mirror task env. bucket policy reviewed; you'll need `x-amz-meta-source: hf` header for PUTs.
Ana: example presign command i used (failed):
```
curl -X PUT -T pytorch_model.bin "$(aws s3 presign s3://redwood-internal/models/zeta-lite/1.0/pytorch_model.bin --expires-in 3600)"
```
Devon: try with header and sha256 metadata, e.g.:
```
curl -X PUT -H "x-amz-meta-source: hf" -H "x-amz-meta-sha256: abc123..." -T pytorch_model.bin "$(aws s3 presign s3://... --expires-in 7200)"
```
Saria: regarding tokenizer charset quirk: this model's tokenizer.json declares `utf-8` but there are non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) in some vocab entries. our tokenizer loader strips normal spaces but not non-breaking ones, so tokens shift. simple fix: normalize in loader to NFKC + replace U+00A0 with space before building vocab mapping. i'll open a tiny patch.
Ana: awesome. two operational asks: 1) can someone add a registry metadata field `orig_uri` pointing to HF path; 2) add a preflight CI check that validates checksum type and tokenizer load pass?
Matt: i'll add a checklist to the onboarding PR. will ping security for bucket ACL confirmation.
Devon: i'll change mirror job to write `tokenizer.normalized.json` and include both checksums. also adding a lint rule that fails if checksum algorithm != sha256.
artifact-bot: mirror job #482 queued -> started. note: will upload files to `s3://redwood-internal/models/zeta-lite/1.0/` with metadata `x-amz-meta-source:hf` and `x-amz-meta-sha256:abc123...`.
Ana: great — if mirror completes without errors, i can run the serving smoke tests. can we aim to have mirror + smoketest by EOD? :clock3:
Saria: i can run smoke tests once artifact-bot reports success. i'll validate tokenizer normalization against our sample prompt set.
Matt: i'll handle the PR for CI lint + presign env docs. tagging this thread with :eyes: for follow-ups.
Devon: quick note — if anyone hits permission denied still, mention `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/model-mirror` in the ticket and i'll escalate.
Ana: thanks all, keeping this thread as the single source for the onboarding checklist. will post results when smoke tests finish. :raised_hands:
